title: Prepare one bounded model question
summary: Use the fixed Video or Quanta single-question profile. This is separate from the tool-calling agent step: a two-message, nonstreaming request with a 512-token profile and 25000-micro ceiling.

replaceability.why: The fixed model profile, cost ceiling and selected provider call are part of the Lumeri spending foundation.
replaceability.decided: Self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18); charter rule 6; today's code: lumeri_runtime/model_ingress.py:93-124

operations.name: profile_for_product
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced; this is a synchronous in-process call.

operations.name: prepare_paid_model_turn

resource_scope.description: request_kind chat_completion, profile/selection/model, whole-prompt hash, max_tokens and profile/effective cost ceilings.

provider_call.description: Python AccountsProviderCall or BrokerProviderCall; see iface:model.routing/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline; preparation does not itself call or charge a provider. Identity and input validation codes are delegated. Effective cash cap is zero for subscription, otherwise min(profile ceiling, Session balance). Fixed request sends system+user only, stream false and parallel_tool_calls false; no tool declaration or agent conversation. Same inputs naturally produce equivalent prepared authority.

invariants.text: The Video and Quanta single-question profiles retain 512 output tokens and 25000 cost micros, distinct from the Video agent-step profile.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: No replacement seam or run-time interface validator exists for this role today; the class describes who may eventually replace it.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

open_questions.text: Add original-profile conformance coverage for both products; the agent-step regressions do not prove this distinct single-question profile.
